_note: v3 Phase 5: the catalogue of API keys. NAMES ONLY, never values. Each key says what it is for and which playbooks and tools depend on it: a failing key pauses only those playbooks (rule 20). Values are written once from the Keys page into Cloudflare Secrets Store (locally: a fake store, or .dev.vars) and injected inside the tool registry.

keys.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
keys.label: Claude API
keys.purpose: Drafting, checking and research steps (only once MODEL_LIVE is "1").

keys.name: CH_API_KEY
keys.label: Companies House API
keys.purpose: Refreshing company facts before a check or a lead.

keys.name: CH_STREAM_KEY
keys.label: Companies House streaming
keys.purpose: The change feed (polling covers it while unset).

keys.name: EMAIL_API_KEY
keys.label: Email sending provider
keys.purpose: Sending outreach and customer emails (provider chosen later, decision D1).

keys.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
keys.label: Stripe (test mode only)
keys.purpose: Card checkout. Refused unless it is a TEST key (v2 rule 9).

keys.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
keys.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
keys.purpose: Checking that payment notifications really came from Stripe.

keys.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
keys.label: Gemini API
keys.purpose: Website extraction with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, only when models.json website_extractor.model is "gemini-4-hydrogen". No agent uses it.
